patch_description: This redesign uses a population-based, two-stage contact optimization architecture instead of sequential independent restarts. A vectorized pool of candidate configurations is optimized simultaneously with a smooth closest/farthest-pair objective, then the strongest candidates are selected, diversified by controlled perturbations, and polished with a sharper continuation schedule. Pair topology, normalization, scoring, selection, and optimization are separated into small helpers for clearer data flow and easier maintenance.
